principles: Weather should usually change creative, copy, channel phasing or tactical triggers before it changes annual budget.
Average monthly weather is planning context, not a forecast.
Live weather should only trigger action when a production connector, threshold and approval rule exist.
Weather logic must distinguish national AV/CTV consumption effects from local OOH and postcode-level effects.

monthly_averages.planning_read: Indoor family media and evening co-viewing are relatively strong.
Half-term and indoor routines can lift daytime family media availability.
Spring optimism can support prize storytelling, but weather is variable.
Easter and changeable spring weather make flexible creative useful.
recommended_actions: OOH London test only with local context

monthly_averages.planning_read: A good month for creative learning because outdoor optimism rises but budget is lower.
Warmer weather and World Cup viewing can shift attention between outdoor activity and screen moments.
Summer holidays and warm spells can reduce routine media but create outdoor/mobile moments.
Late summer and bank holiday weather can create strong local mobility but weaker routine response.
Back-to-school routine reset makes weather less important than habit re-entry.
Darker evenings and wetter weather can support indoor media, but approval governance is the bigger job.
Wet, dark evenings suit AV and indoor channels, but retail noise and November budget scale need discipline.
recommended_actions: Do not let weather justify weak evidence

monthly_averages.planning_read: Festive indoor co-viewing is strong, but disruption and short deadlines need caveats.

live_weather_triggers.condition: Sustained heavy rain, named storm or transport disruption in priority regions
live_weather_triggers.default_action: Move from outdoor optimism to indoor/family/TV copy. Check OOH delivery and avoid insensitive creative.
live_weather_triggers.approval_rule: Requires planner review before any budget movement.

live_weather_triggers.condition: Extended high-temperature spell or public health heat alert
live_weather_triggers.default_action: Use light creative and mobile/social timing carefully. Avoid pressure-heavy messaging during discomfort.
live_weather_triggers.approval_rule: Creative and phasing changes only unless deterministic re-plan is approved.

live_weather_triggers.condition: Sunny forecast around a bank holiday or school holiday window
live_weather_triggers.default_action: Consider local mobility and family-outing creative, especially in London test areas.

live_weather_triggers.condition: Below-average cold snap with high indoor media consumption likelihood
live_weather_triggers.default_action: Lean into home, family and evening co-viewing creative.
live_weather_triggers.approval_rule: Creative switch can be pre-approved; budget remains deterministic.

agent_questions: Which weather conditions should change creative only versus phasing or budget?
